note: Released design for the FPGA board, an iCEBreaker-like board with a root of trust added. Stands in for the full design package (schematic, Gerbers, pick-and-place); its digest is the board HBOM's design subject. U5 holds U1's CRESET_B low and owns the SPI flash until it has verified every image in it.

bom.description: Bare PCB, 4 layer FR-4, 85 x 50 mm
iCE40 UltraPlus 5K FPGA, QFN-48; no secure-boot ROM, configures itself from U2 when CRESET_B rises
128 Mbit SPI NOR flash, SOIC-8: bitstream, boot manifest and SoC firmware
Board root of trust (the example's simulated part): gates U1 CRESET_B and the flash's chip select
1.2 V 500 mA LDO for the FPGA core, SOT-23-5
3.3 V 500 mA LDO for I/O and flash, SOT-23-5
10 kOhm 1% 0402: CRESET_B pull-down, flash chip-select pull-up, RoT reset
